descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Project description 
 Our client is a leading global Financial market data provider who runs a number of change programs to deliver high-quality software that connects Financial Markets across the globe in a real-time, high-frequency, and low-latency data management chain. The projects are technically challenging in an environment that is very engaging.
 We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Python to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for backend systems and services running under Linux, AWS, and Windows, with capabilities to collaborate in a team-focused environment and coordinate work with BA, Dev, Operational, and cross-functional application teams.
 Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts using Python
Create detailed test plans, test cases, and coordinate testing activities
Develop and execute automation scripts for API, integration, and regression testing
Identify, record, document, and track bugs; perform regression testing when resolved
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipeline integrations for automated test execution
Liaise with internal teams to identify system requirements and resolve quality issues
Track quality assurance metrics and stay up-to-date with new testing tools and strategies
Knowledge of tools such as Git, Jira, TestRail, Confluence
 Skills 
 Must have 
Strong Python development skills for test automation
5+ years of relevant experience in software testing
hands-on experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks (e.g. pytest, Robot Framework, TestNG, Selenium)
Experience in API automation testing (REST/SOAP)
A good Linux background
Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar)
Thorough understanding of the software development lifecycle
Practical expertise in both manual and automated testing methodologies and tools
 Nice to have 
Familiarity with banking, financial concepts, financial data, and market data
Knowledge of protocols and any experience with client/server implementations/API or testing message sequences over socket/websocket connections
